summary: Customer is developing a hot polymer extrusion process containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient and wants to investigate whether an optical measurement can detect composition changes in the melt. They have offline assays, note the process interface is hot and may suffer material build up, and request an initial comparison plan plus questions before choosing a probe.
